title: Don Young American Grown Act

summary:
Don Young American Grown Act

This bill prohibits the official display of a cut flower or green in any public area of a building of the Executive Office of the President, the Department of State, or the Department of Defense unless it is grown in the United States.

The prohibition does not apply to any cut flower or green used by a federal officer or employee for personal display.
